title: Caesar wins the Battle of Thapsus
summary: Julius Caesar defeated the republican forces of Metellus Scipio and their Numidian ally King Juba I at Thapsus in North Africa.
reason: After Pompey's death his supporters had regrouped in the province of Africa to continue the civil war.
significance: The defeat led to the suicide of Cato the Younger and ended organised republican resistance in Africa.
